_comment: SSRF via OOB — SAFE (must NOT confirm). Drives the ssrf_target lab (GET /fetch-safe?url=), which validates the URL host against a strict allow-list and refuses the probe domain BEFORE any request — so no out-of-band callback occurs and the result is REFUTED, never CONFIRMED. Boot the lab first: python -m uvicorn ssrf_target.main:app --port 8004. Run: python run.py ssrf --config examples/run.ssrf_safe.json
